newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends up on refiner buying.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends up on refiner buying.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices rebounded and closed higher on refiners' buying and year-end covering. Activity was mostly among inter-month switchings. Double-digit gains were seen. Feb fell to 1,178 low before rebounding at close.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Talk of refiner buying and that Pakistan may issue fresh tenders helped prices. Interest was widespread.
At the close, February futures closed 11 ringgit up at 1,195 ringgit ($475.02) a tonne.
"Inter-month switching activities were still seen in the market today," another trader said.

The market is expected to trade within tight ranges if there are no new developments until the release of a crop report from forecaster Ivan Wong on Friday and official Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority (PORLA) data on Monday.
"If the PORLA's data are going to be within market expectations and there are no fresh tenders, we will see a lethargic market until the end of the year," the trader said.
Traders had estimated output in November to fall by up to 15 percent from October, and put end-November stocks at 965,000 to 980,000 tonnes. Exports are projected at 655,000 tonnes.
Expectations of fresh tenders from Pakistan also underpinned sentiment, traders said.
Turnover on the futures was 1,310 lots against 2,005 on Tuesday.

Among physicals, Dec (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,217.50 ringgit after trading from 1,205 to 1,212.50. Bids for Dec (south) was 1,215. Dec (central) saw offers at 1,210 and bids at 1,205, and Dec (north) at 1,200 against 1,195.
Jan (south) saw offers at 1,222.50 and bids at 1,217.50 with earlier trades at 1,215 and 1,217.50. Feb (south) was offered at 1,225 and bids at 1,217.50 after trading from 1,215 to 1,217.50.
Among refined products, Dec RBD palm oil was offered at $520 a tonne FOB Malaysia, and Jan/Feb/Mar at $515. Dec was traded $517.50 and Jan at $510.
Dec RBD palm olein saw offers at $562.50, Jan at $555 and Feb/Mar at $550. Jan was traded at $550.
Dec RBD palm stearin was offered at $372.50, Jan at $375 and Feb/Mar at $382.50. Dec/Jan palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $290.--Tan Lee Lee (603-2307510) ($1=2.5220 ringgit)
